sentence: This project tries to find counterexamples that show where smart systems with AI parts fail to meet their properties, using simulation.
This project sets up a Security Operation Center and builds on a cyber security curriculum in computer science.
This project studies online adult advertisements to understand how their websites work and how they link to human trafficking and other organized crime.
This project builds a way to sort cells without antibodies, using specially engineered polymeric materials that change with temperature.
This project tests whether a visual area of the bird forebrain processes the light-dependent magnetic compass, by measuring how its neurons respond.
This project builds a processor-in-memory system using memristors made from carbohydrate materials extracted from plants, aiming to use less energy and waste.
This project tries to explain why deep networks work by building deep learning methods based on low-dimensional structures in data.
This project studies how plastic debris in ponds affects microbial communities and how long plastic and microplastics stay there.
This project studies a group of aquatic fungi called blastoclads, using single cell genomics to find species and work out how they are related.
This project builds fluorescent probes that light up near peroxynitrite, to see where cells make it and how mechanical cues change it.
This project studies how behavior and hormones of a non-human primate species respond to acute environmental changes and relate to health and reproductive fitness.
This project explores whether compact autonomous rail vehicles that inspect track and repair defects could suit freight railroads.
This project builds transparent light-emitting diodes from ternary copper halides and studies how these materials produce broadband emission.
This project builds a cybersecurity program with research on AI and cybersecurity, embedded systems security and network security.
This project builds a compact radio frequency analog co-processor using 3D printing and composite ink with phase-changing nanoparticles.
This project builds algorithms that use combinatorial tools to break combined representations into basic building blocks called irreducible representations.
This project studies how the structures of specialized metabolites called acylsugars change the way plants and insects interact.
